summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Print and Save ERP. All 18 backend API tests pass (auth, dashboard, settings, CRUD for 5 resources, all 4 calculators, equipment cost, auth guard). Frontend Playwright E2E: login->dashboard SPA navigation WORKS (primary concern verified), all 6 module pages load, all 4 calculators return results, settings save persists, logout returns to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 567 lines and mixes models, auth, CRUD factory, calc helpers, and routes; consider splitting into modules (auth, models, calc, routers) if it continues to grow.

/api/calc/sticker returns material as a string (name) while /api/calc/largeformat returns material as a dict. Inconsistent shape may confuse frontend consumers; consider standardizing to a dict with id+name.

JWT stored in localStorage (pns_token) in addition to httpOnly cookie — httpOnly cookie is set but frontend uses Bearer from localStorage, so the cookie is effectively unused. Pick one strategy to avoid confusion / XSS risk.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends lockout after 5 fails). Currently unlimited attempts.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; backend startup already seeds admin + demo paper stocks, products, roll materials, equipment, size presets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. JWT token in localStorage key 'pns_token'. Sticker calc endpoint returns results with material as string (name), not dict. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` from /app after exporting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Login->Dashboard SPA navigation verified working: after POST /api/auth/login the frontend sets pns_token in localStorage, AuthContext updates, and <Navigate> in Login.js sends user to /, which renders Dashboard (data-testid=dashboard-page).
